notes:
Version 2.4.3
- Fixed incorrect silent-install switches for both ViGEmBus and HidHide.
- Driver setup now writes persistent Windows Installer logs and a setup summary.
- Added an Open setup logs button on failure instead of generic restart advice.
- Existing drivers are checked for their files and enabled service configuration.
- Correctly handles restart-required results, cancelled setup and another installation in progress.
- Bounded retry for a busy Windows Installer and one visible-progress recovery attempt for bootstrapper failures.
- Verified downloads are reused when retrying setup. The web installer remains under 10 MB.

Version 2.4.2
- The app is now English only, including updates, overlays and app error messages.
- Removed the language selector. Previous language preferences automatically use English.
- Simplified the website and translated every page and release note into English.
- The installer is now English only. Automatic driver downloads and updates are unchanged.
- Small web installer under 10 MB: the app and missing drivers are downloaded during setup.
- Removed unnecessary setup pages and our own copyright notices.

Version 2.4.1
- Renamed the app to PS-Controller.
- Added the blue, underlined Bondo credit linking to Discord.
- Installer automatically sets up missing ViGEmBus and HidHide drivers.
- Automatic update checks and verified downloads; installation starts when you choose.
- Public website and releases. Application source remains private.

Version 2.4.0
- Added a Windows installer with automatic ViGEmBus and HidHide downloads.
- Automatic update checks at startup and every six hours.
- Updates are downloaded and SHA-256 verified; you choose when to install.
- Added public information, download and release pages. Application source remains private.
